alt: Sundar Pichai, CEO of Google and Alphabet, on stage at the Google I/O developer conference at Moscone Center in San Francisco, presenting to a packed auditorium of developers with the Google I/O stage backdrop and lighting visible behind him
story: Google's Gemini 3.5 Pro — announced at Google I/O in May 2026, with CEO Sundar Pichai telling a visibly frustrated crowd of developers 'Give us until next month to get it to you' — has since missed its promised June launch and its rescheduled July 17 target, making it the most publicly broken tech promise of the year.
why_funny: The CEO of the world's most powerful search and AI infrastructure company promised his flagship model three times and missed all three, while rival models GPT-5.6 and Grok 4.5 already shipped.
